Class EcsAgentAdapter

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.ecs.systems.EcsAgentAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
AgentView
public class EcsAgentAdapter extends Object implements AgentView
Flyweight Adapter that makes an ECS Entity look like an AgentView. This object is reused (setEntityId is called for each entity).
